about: The link's words for requests that end on evidence (docs/LINK-RESILIENCE.md §1, docs/PROTOCOL.md): what the app sends as margin-core encodes it (app/shared/core/src/protocol.rs), what a copy sends as the core reads it, and what a copy (extension/background/link.ts) answers to each. Read by protocol.rs's tests, the Mac's unit checks (tests.swift, through the core) and tests/link.test.ts. Old and new both ways: an older copy's tock has no seq (life only), an older app's tick has none (its tock has none).

app.about: a tick, numbered from 1 on each link
a cancel: the app no longer waits for that req

copy.about: a tock with its tick's number: the copy read everything sent before that tick
an older copy's tock: life only
a seq that isn't a whole number: life only
an ack: the copy read that req and takes it

answers.about: a numbered tick: its number echoed
an older app's tick: a tock with no number
a req: acked as it's read, before it runs
